concept: Being brave doesn't mean not being scared — it means doing the right thing even when you are scared
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character feels genuinely scared but does the right thing anyway
exercise.reflection_prompt: Was the character not scared, or brave anyway? What's the difference?
exercise.practice: Student names a time they felt scared but did something anyway

assessment.success_marker: student can explain that courage includes fear, not the absence of it
